responsibility: Implements integer and pointer range operators for GCC’s ranger infrastructure. This file defines how tree operations fold over irange inputs, how result ranges are rewritten back into operand ranges, how known-bit masks and shift validity are handled, and how operator-specific relation information is derived, then installs the operator implementations used by range_op_handler to reason about arithmetic, bitwise, cast, shift, and comparison expressions in SSA range propagation.
same_name_distinction: Implements the operator-semantics engine for ranger—folding operations over ranges, back-propagating operand constraints, handling bitmasks/shifts, and deriving relations; unlike gcc/range.h/gcc/range.cc, it is about per-operator reasoning, not simple canonical range constructors.
